# hvrg_sampling (Resource)

The sampling records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) display name, the key a default rule is replaced by
- `rule` (Dynamic) kind always, error, latency with latency_ms, probabilistic with percent, or rate_limit

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) false skips the rule
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization
- `priority` (Number) lower runs first
